contextBlurb: Maine is leaning restrictive on data centers and advancing regulation on AI. On data centers: LD912 (enacted) — Would cap the amount of electricity that can be supplied to data centers on commercial or industrial sites in Maine. On AI: LD2082 (enacted) — Establishes rules for how artificial intelligence can be used when providing mental health services in Maine.

legislation.title: An Act to Establish the Maine Data Center Coordination Council and Place a Temporary Limitation on Certain Data Centers
legislation.summary: Maine establishes a Data Center Coordination Council and imposes a temporary limitation on the development of certain data centers in the state. This creates a coordinated review process while restricting new data center construction during a specified period.

legislation.title: An Act to Regulate and Prevent Children's Access to Artificial Intelligence Chatbots with Human-like Features and Social Artificial Intelligence Companions
legislation.summary: This Maine bill would regulate or ban children's access to AI chatbots that mimic human conversation and AI social companions. It aims to protect minors from potentially harmful interactions with human-like AI systems.

legislation.title: An Act to Exclude Data Centers from the Business Equipment Tax Exemption and the Dirigo Business Incentives Program and to Require the Department of Economic and Community Development to Study Financial Incentives for Data Centers
legislation.summary: This Maine bill would remove data centers from existing business equipment tax exemptions and a state business incentive program, effectively ending preferential financial treatment for data centers. It also directs the state's economic development agency to study what financial incentives, if any, should apply to data centers in the future.

legislation.title: An Act to Regulate the Use of Artificial Intelligence in Providing Certain Mental Health Services
legislation.summary: This bill establishes rules for how artificial intelligence can be used when providing mental health services in Maine. It puts guardrails around AI-driven mental health tools to protect patients and ensure appropriate oversight.

legislation.title: An Act to Prohibit the Use of Artificial Intelligence in the Denial of Health Insurance Claims
legislation.summary: This Maine bill would ban health insurance companies from using artificial intelligence to deny claims, requiring human decision-making in coverage denials. It aims to protect patients from automated rejections of their health insurance claims.

legislation.title: Resolve, Directing the Maine Arts Commission to Study Federal and National Efforts to Protect Artists from Copyright Infringement by Artificial Intelligence Companies and Users and to Monitor Educational Use
legislation.summary: This bill directs Maine's Arts Commission to study how federal and other states' laws are protecting artists from having their work used without permission by AI companies. The commission would also monitor how AI is being used in educational settings.

legislation.title: An Act to Ensure Transparency in Consumer Transactions Involving Artificial Intelligence
legislation.summary: This bill requires businesses to disclose when consumers are interacting with artificial intelligence during transactions. It aims to ensure people know when AI, rather than a human, is handling their purchase or service experience.

legislation.title: An Act to Ensure Determinations Made by the State Are Free from Unethical, Unsafe or Illegal Interference by Artificial Intelligence
legislation.summary: This bill aims to prevent artificial intelligence from improperly influencing or making official state government decisions. It establishes safeguards to ensure that state determinations remain free from unethical, unsafe, or illegal AI interference.

legislation.title: An Act to Prohibit Landlords from Setting Rents Through the Use of Artificial Intelligence
legislation.summary: This Maine bill prohibits landlords from using artificial intelligence algorithms to set rental prices. The law restricts an automated decision-making tool commonly used in the housing market to prevent discriminatory or opaque rent-setting practices.

legislation.title: An Act to Protect Minors from Harmful Depictions Generated by Artificial Intelligence
legislation.summary: This bill prohibits the creation or distribution of AI-generated depictions that sexually exploit or otherwise harm minors. It establishes protections specifically targeting artificial intelligence tools used to produce harmful content involving children.

legislation.title: An Act to Limit the Amount of Electricity That May Be Provided to Data Centers on a Certain Commercial or Industrial Site
legislation.summary: This bill would cap the amount of electricity that can be supplied to data centers on commercial or industrial sites in Maine. It is designed to limit the strain that large data center operations can place on the electrical grid.

legislation.title: An Act to Ensure Human Oversight in Medical Insurance Payment Decisions
legislation.summary: This bill requires that human beings, not automated systems or AI, make final decisions about medical insurance payment approvals and denials. It ensures patients have access to human review rather than having their care determined solely by algorithms.

legislation.title: Resolve, to Study the Effects of Artificial Intelligence, Cellular Telephones and Social Media on Public Education
legislation.summary: Maine establishes a study to examine how artificial intelligence, cellular phones, and social media affect public education. The resolve directs analysis of impacts on students and schools to inform future policy.
